description: Draggable toolbox item component for survey builder panels, displaying an icon and label with drag handle (GripVertical). Supports enabled/disabled, dragging, and non-draggable (click-only) states.
useCases: Question type item in survey builder toolbox (drag to canvas)
Logic block item in workflow builder palette
Widget item in dashboard builder sidebar
Non-draggable action item in a toolbox panel (click to insert)
